description:
You are a library technician managing a digital media catalog database (Chinook) in LibreOffice Base. The database has over 3,500 tracks and search performance has degraded. You need to create three indexes to optimize common query patterns.

Open the SQL execution dialog via 'Tools > SQL...' and create the following three indexes:

1. Index named "idx_Track_Name" on the "Track" table, column "Name"
   SQL: CREATE INDEX "idx_Track_Name" ON "Track"("Name")

2. Index named "idx_Track_Composer" on the "Track" table, column "Composer"
   SQL: CREATE INDEX "idx_Track_Composer" ON "Track"("Composer")

3. Composite index named "idx_Invoice_Cust_Date" on the "Invoice" table, columns "CustomerId" and "InvoiceDate" (in that order)
   SQL: CREATE INDEX "idx_Invoice_Cust_Date" ON "Invoice"("CustomerId","InvoiceDate")

After creating all three indexes, save the database using Ctrl+S or File > Save to persist changes to the ODB file at /home/ga/chinook.odb.
